territories.name: Lesotho
territories.legal_reference: Directive 2006/112/EC, article 5(2): the common system of VAT applies in the territory of the Community as defined by the Treaties, and a State outside it is a third country for every rule the Directive carries. Lesotho levies a value added tax of its own under the Value Added Tax Act, 2001 (Act No. 9 of 2001), administered by Revenue Services Lesotho: section 12 makes the supply of goods or services by a vendor a taxable supply and section 19 leaves the rates to regulation, at most four including a zero rate, with 15 per cent on most goods and services, 10 per cent on electricity, a zero rate on exports and basic commodities, and the exempt supplies of section 6.
